verdict.rationale: Chronicle documents the full loop from traces to offline evals. Production traces can be ingested through the SDK or an OpenTelemetry exporter and searched semantically, and individual traces become tasks via "Add trace". Tasks group into suites with code or LLM-judge scorers and thresholds, and evaluations run against frozen, version-pinned suites, including baseline-vs-candidate comparison. Missing for 10: documentation of bulk or filtered dataset curation from production traces (beyond adding single traces), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the trace-to-task workflow.
